# Recorded conventional MBA and rejected HD3 regression

These exact archived cells are TEST INPUTS ONLY, never an installed expert seed,
reference lattice or cross-project design basis. Source: project-43020af6b28939.
The manifest records source, canonical JSON hashes, original machine contract,
unit-transfer groups and expected measured quantities. Do not update expected
values merely to make a regression pass.

The parent is the accepted 3.5 GeV / 32-cell / 800 m conventional linear
prototype, about 52.956 pm. The unit and original assembly preserve its transfer
provenance. HD3 is a rejected trial, not a replacement working lattice.

The opt-in regression re-evaluates the saved cells and explicit full ring using
JuTrack, checks the parent acceptance and compares HD3 through matching and
acceptance measurement paths. It does not regenerate TME, rematch or optimize.
No nonlinear, chromatic-correction or topology-exhaustion claim follows.
